title.en: Pneumothorax is an outline for concrete pump split piston φ150, not a second table
title.zh: 《Pneumothorax》是concrete pump split piston φ150的大纲，不是第二张表

description.en: Section titles come from Pneumothorax; the concrete pump split piston φ150 figures stay the printed ones. A φ150 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are rubber only. No published pump page assigns φ150 to a model.
description.zh: 节标题来自《Pneumothorax》，concrete pump split piston φ150的数字仍是已印数字。φ150 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是只有橡胶。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ150 指定到某一型号。

h1.en: Pneumothorax sets the order for the concrete pump split piston φ150 note
h1.zh: 《Pneumothorax》决定这篇concrete pump split piston φ150笔记的次序

directAnswer.en: The short answer for concrete pump split piston φ150 uses the cells Xingtai already printed. Pneumothorax is the outline those cells are filed under. A φ150 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are rubber only. No published pump page assigns φ150 to a model.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump split piston φ150的简答只用邢台已经印出的格子。《Pneumothorax》是这些格子所依的大纲。 φ150 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是只有橡胶。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ150 指定到某一型号。

body.en: Read “Signs and symptoms” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. The split piston is a replacement set for S-valve concrete pumps, supplied from Xingtai by Hebei Pinjin Machinery. The full outer-diameter list is φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280. This note is only the φ150 row, materials: rubber only. Unit: set. The page does not print a compound grade, a hardness, or a service life. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The integral-piston page is a different part. Where the same φ150 also appears there, it is still not a pump-model assignment. Electric 20's 80 mm figure is a pipe inner diameter, not a piston outer diameter. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 把“来源章节：Signs and symptoms”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 分体活塞是河北品锦机械从邢台供应的 S 阀混凝土泵替换套件。全部外径是 φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280。本文只写 φ150 这一行，材料：只有橡胶。单位：套。页面没有印胶料牌号、硬度或寿命。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 整体活塞是另一件配件。若同一个 φ150 也出现在那边，仍然不是泵型号的指定。电动20的 80 mm 是输送管内径，不是活塞外径。 标题到此为止。

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Cause”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write split piston, φ150, the material row (rubber only), and the quantity in sets. Leave life and pump model blank if the machine check is not done. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 来源页在“来源章节：Cause”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明分体活塞、φ150、材料行（只有橡胶）和套数。若还没在机器上核对，寿命和泵型号留空。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Mechanism”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. A φ150 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are rubber only. No published pump page assigns φ150 to a model. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“机理”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 φ150 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是只有橡胶。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ150 指定到某一型号。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Diagnosis”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“来源章节：Diagnosis”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Treatment”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“处理”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: Use “Prevention” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 分体活塞 page plus this size and the quantity. The outline does not complete a blank. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumothorax
body.zh: 用“预防”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明分体活塞这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 大纲补不上空白格子。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pneumothorax
